scares.a: A scarecrow turns its head to watch you. It is only straw.
scares.b: A pumpkin grins up from the hedge. Its candle gutters, friendly enough.
scares.c: A ghost sheet drifts past, wearing a bow tie. It nods politely.

talkers.v: A villager peeks out between the hedges. "Did the scarecrow turn for you too? He always does."
